verdict.rationale: Signifyd is a SaaS fraud-protection platform, so an official CLI is a fair thing to ask about. The evidence documents only a REST API, webhooks, mobile SDKs and a device-profiling script, and never mentions a command-line tool. Those are adjacent developer building blocks, not a CLI, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
